install.description: Links /etc/localtime to the requested IANA zone and writes /etc/timezone. No-op when already set.
install.title: Install timezone

uninstall.description: Resets the system timezone to UTC. No-op when already UTC.
uninstall.title: Uninstall timezone

update.description: Reconciles /etc/localtime and /etc/timezone to the requested zone. Same behavior as install.
update.title: Update timezone

verify.description: Read-only check that /etc/localtime and /etc/timezone point at the requested zone. Exits non-zero when they do not.
verify.title: Verify timezone

description: Sets the system timezone (IANA zone, e.g. /Europe/Berlin) by linking /etc/localtime and writing /etc/timezone. Uninstall resets the system to UTC. Targets Debian 12/13 and Ubuntu 22.04/24.04.
name: timezone
title: Timezone
